Separate outDir per suite — see tests/tsconfig.registry.json for why. `lib/record.ts` is M13-3's whole derivation and it imports nothing at runtime beyond `lib/diagnosis.ts` (M13-1's row readers, reused rather than re-implemented, and itself I/O-free); `lib/mistakes/types.ts` is types-only and erases at compile time. There is no Supabase client, no clock and no next/* anywhere in either. That is what lets M13-3's done-when — six months renders, and renders without an unbounded read — be proved with no live project in reach (U.3). The database verbs are injected as an interface with five READ methods and no write method; the tests supply a double that counts the queries it is asked for.
